original_goal: Build a To-Do app using Flask with SQLite and HTML frontend

plan.description: A simple To-Do app that allows users to create, read, update and delete tasks.

steps.title: Set up the project directory and requirements file
steps.description: Create a new project directory and initialize the project with Flask and SQLite. Create a requirements.txt file to manage dependencies.

steps.title: Create the database model
steps.description: Define a SQLite database model for tasks using SQLAlchemy. Create a models folder and an __init__.py file to organize the model.
steps.code_hint: Create a task model with fields for title, description, and due date

steps.title: Create routes for CRUD operations
steps.description: Define Flask routes for creating, reading, updating, and deleting tasks. Create an app folder to organize the routes.
steps.code_hint: Define routes for tasks CRUD operations

steps.title: Create HTML templates for task views
steps.description: Design and create HTML templates for displaying tasks. Create a templates folder to organize the templates.
steps.code_hint: Design a template for displaying tasks

steps.title: Write unit tests
steps.description: Write unit tests to ensure the application works correctly. Create a tests folder to organize the tests.
steps.code_hint: Write tests for tasks CRUD operations

steps.title: Create README.md documentation
steps.description: Write a README file to document the project, its features, and usage.
